privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.intro: QR-Universe (“we”) operates a platform that lets businesses publish digital catalogs opened by QR code. This policy explains what personal data we process, why, and what choices you have. It covers the public website, the admin dashboard, and catalogs we host.

sections.heading: 1. Who is responsible
body: The controller of personal data processed through this service is the operator of QR-Universe. For privacy requests call or WhatsApp +90 541 323 00 02. We answer in Azerbaijani, Turkish, English and Russian.
If you browse a merchant’s catalog, that merchant is responsible for the product content they publish. We host that content on their behalf.

sections.heading: 2. Data we collect
body: Account data: name, email, password hash (never stored in plain text), company profile and catalog content you upload, and the time you accepted the terms.
Usage data: QR scan events (time, language, optional device type), product-sheet opens, and a random visitor id used only to count people currently viewing a catalog.
Technical data: a session cookie after login, language and theme preference, and cookie-consent choice. Short-lived server logs may include IP address for security.
Abuse reports from catalog guests: the catalog, the reason chosen, optional details, a hashed network identifier and user-agent. Used only to review violations.

sections.heading: 3. Why we use it
body: To run your workspace, show your catalog to guests, count real scans, keep you signed in, remember language and theme, and to answer support.
To review reports of prohibited catalogs and enforce the terms.
We do not sell personal data. We do not run advertising networks or third-party marketing pixels.

sections.heading: 4. Sharing
body: Infrastructure processors (PostgreSQL and object storage hosted by Neon) store data solely to run the product.
We disclose data if required by law or to protect the service against abuse. We do not share catalogs with other merchants.

sections.heading: 5. Retention
body: Account and catalog data stay while your workspace is active. Deleting the workspace in Settings removes the company, catalog, QR codes, scans and the owner login.
Anonymous online-presence pings expire automatically in under a minute.
Abuse reports are kept as long as needed to investigate and protect the service.

sections.heading: 6. Your rights
body: You may access, correct or delete your workspace from Settings, or contact us at the number above for a copy of your account data.
You may lodge a complaint with a data-protection authority in your country of residence.

sections.heading: 7. Children
body: The service is intended for businesses. We do not knowingly collect data from children under 16.

sections.heading: 8. Changes
body: We will update this page when our practices change and revise the date above.

terms.title: Terms of service
terms.intro: These terms govern your use of QR-Universe. By creating an account or publishing a catalog you agree to them. If you use the product for a company, you confirm you are authorised to bind that company.

sections.heading: 1. The service
body: QR-Universe lets you create categories and products, design QR codes, and publish a public catalog. Guests scan the code and open the catalog in a mobile browser — no app install.
We may improve features. Plan limits are shown in the product. We will give reasonable notice of material reductions.

sections.heading: 2. Your account
body: Provide accurate details and keep your password confidential. You are responsible for activity under your login.
The workspace belongs to the company you register. You may delete it at any time from Settings; deletion is permanent.

sections.heading: 3. Your content
body: You own the photos, text, prices and QR artwork you upload. You grant us a licence to host and display that content solely to operate your catalog and QR codes.
You confirm you have the rights to that content and that it is not illegal or infringing.

sections.heading: 4. Acceptable use
body: Do not probe or overload the service, impersonate others, or use catalogs to sell goods in a way that breaks applicable law.
We may suspend a workspace that violates these terms, after notice where reasonably possible.

sections.heading: 5. Plans, availability and liability
body: Free, Pro and Enterprise describe current entitlements. Paid plans are arranged with us directly — there is no card checkout on the site.

The service is provided as-is. We aim for high availability but do not warrant uninterrupted QR scans. To the fullest extent permitted by law we are not liable for lost profits or issues on the guest’s device.
Nothing limits liability for fraud, death or personal injury caused by negligence, or any liability that cannot be excluded by law.

sections.heading: 6. Prohibited content and enforcement
body: You must be 18 or older to create an account. Catalogs are for lawful business only. You must not upload, sell, advertise or otherwise publish: adult or pornographic material; any sexual content involving minors (strictly forbidden and will be reported); illegal drugs or related offers that break the law; weapons, explosives or instructions to make them; stolen, counterfeit or smuggled goods; fraud, phishing or money-laundering schemes; hate, threats, harassment or doxxing; malware or attacks on the service; copyright-infringing copies you do not have rights to; or any other content that is illegal where you or your customers are located.

If you break these rules we may, without prior notice where the risk is serious, suspend or permanently close the workspace, delete the catalog, block the IP address or other access identifiers we see, and refuse future sign-ups. We may report illegal activity to competent authorities. We are not obliged to review every catalog, but we may remove content when we become aware of a violation.

Guests may report a catalog they believe breaks these rules. We may keep a record of the report (reason, optional details and a hashed network identifier) to investigate and, where needed, block access.

You are solely responsible for everything you publish and for your dealings with customers. QR-Universe does not verify products, does not take title to goods, and is not liable for your content, illegal use of the service, or any loss, claim or penalty arising from what you publish. If a third party brings a claim because of your catalog, you will indemnify us to the extent permitted by law.

sections.heading: 7. Governing law
body: These terms are governed by the laws of the Republic of Türkiye, without prejudice to mandatory consumer protections in your country of residence. Disputes will first be addressed in good faith via +90 541 323 00 02.

cookies.title: Cookie policy
cookies.intro: This page describes the cookies QR-Universe uses. We only set what is needed to run the product — no advertising cookies.

sections.heading: 1. Essential cookies
body: Session cookie (qru_session): keeps you signed in to admin. It is set after login and cleared on logout.
Preference storage: language, theme, and cookie-consent choice so the site does not reset on every visit.
A random visitor id powers the “people viewing this catalog” count. It is not a login and is not used for ads.

sections.heading: 2. What we do not use
body: We do not set advertising, social-media or cross-site tracking cookies, and we do not drop third-party marketing pixels on the public catalog.

sections.heading: 3. How to control them
body: You can delete cookies in your browser. Blocking the session cookie will sign you out of admin.
Questions: +90 541 323 00 02 (WhatsApp available).

banner.text: We use essential cookies only: to keep you signed in, remember language and theme, and count people currently viewing a catalog. No advertising trackers.

guide.title: Build your catalog in 5 minutes
guide.subtitle: From sign-up to a printed QR code — step by step.
guide.videoNote: Under two minutes, from sign-up to a printed QR code.

steps.title: Create your account
steps.body: Hit “Start free”. Name, email, password and your business name. No card needed.

steps.title: Enter the code from your email
steps.body: We send a 6-digit code. Type it on the site. If you don't see the mail, check your spam folder.

steps.title: Set up your business
steps.body: Upload your logo, pick your colour and choose your industry (restaurant, clothing, electronics...). Your catalog takes that look.

steps.title: Create a category
steps.body: In the “Add product” form, type the section name: “Mains”, “Drinks”, “Desserts”... It is created when you save. These are the headings your guests see.

steps.title: Add a product
steps.body: Products → Add product. Photo, name, price, then save. Uploading a photo opens a crop window so every item comes out the same size.

steps.title: Download and print your QR
steps.body: Open QR Studio, pick your colour and download PNG or SVG. Print it and stick it on the table, shelf or window.

steps.title: Change anything, anytime
steps.body: Change a price and you never reprint the QR. The next person who scans sees the new price straight away.
